PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE)
Solicitation No.: SYN-E-0005
Title: On-Call Flight-Line Engineering Disposition Support

1. OBJECTIVE
Provide on-call engineering personnel to the flight line to support
turnaround inspections, troubleshoot avionics and airframe
discrepancies, and issue engineering dispositions affecting aircraft
airworthiness.

2. TASKS
2.1 Respond to flight-line troubleshooting requests raised during
    turnaround maintenance within the response window specified by the
    squadron maintenance officer.
2.2 Render engineering dispositions for avionics/airframe discrepancy
    write-ups in accordance with NATOPS-referenced procedures.
2.3 Maintain a running disposition log in the maintenance data system
    for audit by the engineering disposition authority.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Flight line and hangar deck, notional Naval Air Station.
